description: This PHP class 'DatabaseConfigAPI' handles API requests for database configuration during system upgrade in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It provides methods to get and post database connection info, validate the connection, and manage state.

classes.name: DatabaseConfigAPI
classes.description: API controller for managing database configuration during system upgrade.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save database info and validate connection.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve stored database info.
